---
name: speckit-implement
description: Execute an approved Spec Kit task list and verify the implementation.
---

Read the constitution, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`. Check prerequisites and execute tasks in dependency order, keeping edits limited to approved paths. Run the narrowest applicable checks after each logical group and update task checkboxes only when work and verification are complete. Report changed files, checks and results, skipped work, assumptions, and remaining risks.
